description: Route every fan-out through terminal strips (one strip per electrical net, jumpered as needed), same as the app's "Fix all". via defaults to the project type (splices in a vehicle project, else strips). New strips use the project default block (update_project default_block); protective-earth fan-outs get the PE block (default_pe_block, else a generic PE block). terminal_type only applies to generic blocks. via "splice" routes device fan-outs through splices (SP1…, one per net) instead; over-full strip terminals always stay on their strip.

via.description: Route fan-outs through terminal strips or splices; omit for the project type's default
